tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Returns the MusVideo account connected to this chat (name and email). Use it when the user asks which account is connected.

tools.name: get_credit_balance
tools.description: Returns how many credits remain in the connected MusVideo account. Credits cannot be bought or added from ChatGPT; if the user asks how to get more, say they can't be added here, without links, plans or prices. Do not advise whether or when to change subscriptions, including waiting or changing them

tools.name: import_song
tools.description: Imports a song to use for a music video: either an audio file the user attached in ChatGPT (`file`) or a public link (`audioUrl`: a direct MP3/WAV/M4A/FLAC/OGG link or a public Suno song page). tools.name: cancel_mv_render
tools.description: Stops a render started with start_mv_render. Items that have not started are not charged (queued items are refunded); scenes already finished are kept, and items already being generated may still finish. Confirm with the user before cancelling.

tools.name: list_my_videos
tools.description: Lists the music video projects in the connected MusVideo account, newest first, with status, thumbnail and video link when finished. Read-only.

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Gets one music video with its playable video link, poster image and watch page, and shows a player. Read-only.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_mv_project" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Creates a MusVideo project from an imported song and starts listening to the song and drafting a story for the video. Costs 6 credits (song analysis and story).…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account, create_mv_project, start_mv_render · Private data: import_song · Public sink: get_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account, create_mv_project, start_mv_render · Private data: import_song · Public sink: get_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
